title_sq: APARTAMENT 2+1+2 TUALETE PER SHITJE NE ASTIR!
description_sq:
Disponojme per shitje apartament te tipologjise 2+1+2 tualete ne Astir, prane Bar Artistit.
Apartamenti organizohet ne sallon ndenjeje me kuzhine te perbashket, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete ku njeri prej tyre ndodhet ne dhomen matrimoniale dhe nje verande e bollshme.
Ofrohet i mobiluar si ne foto, me nje arredim bashkekohor.
Pallati eshte i pajisur me ashensor dhe mirembajtje te rregullt.
Zona eshte mjaft e kerkuar, me akses te shpejte ne Unazen e Re dhe facilitete te shumta perreth.
Ideal per banim ose investim.
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni!
title_en: 2+1+2 TOILET APARTMENT FOR SALE IN ASTIR!
description_en: We have for sale a 2+1+2 bathroom typology apartment in Astir, near Bar Artisti. The apartment is organized in a living room with a shared kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, one of which is in the master bedroom and a spacious veranda. It is offered furnished as in the photo, with a contemporary decor. The building is equipped with an elevator and regular maintenance. The area is quite sought after, with quick access to the New Ring Road and numerous facilities around. Ideal for residence or investment. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
